fusions.name: Swinging Links
fusions.desc: Whirls a length of chain around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage.

fusions.name: Reeling Hook
fusions.desc: Hooks a target up to 6 tiles away and hauls you to it, then deals 13 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Haul In
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Next Link
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
